Verify the garden-level memory counts and remembered events
Verify an open future task is absent from memory

Open or future work never appears as completed history

records.behavior: A place or bed with more than twelve memories shows the recent twelve first and exposes every older entry through an explicit expandable control.

Verify twelve timeline rows are initially rendered
Verify the control reports one older entry and aria-expanded=false

The collapsed count is accurate
Expansion state is programmatically exposed

records.behavior: A plant photo journal explains its empty state, groups authorized photos by season and year newest-first, and never renders an image without an available media URL.

steps: Render a plant with no authorized photo URLs and verify the instructive empty state
Provide authorized media URLs for two dated observations in the same season across different years
Verify Summer 2026 and Summer 2025 are separate and newest-first
Verify the observation without a media URL remains text-only
success_criteria: The empty journal remains discoverable
Same-season photos from different years are not merged
Only authorized media URLs become image sources
Duplicate timeline images use decorative alt text while their captions remain visible
records.environment_scope: local deterministic renderer and rendered sample-garden browser
records.safety: synthetic media URLs; no upload or provider call

records.behavior: A grower can record a harvest or lesson, retain entered data after a failed save, and receive next-season guidance derived only from matching outcome history.
records.fixtures: Bell Pepper with a successful 4.0/5 outcome plus isolated strong, weak, empty, and unrelated-history fixtures
steps: Submit a complete harvest or lesson and verify the callback payload
Force the save callback to fail and verify the form and entered note remain available
Generate suggestions from strong, weak, empty, and unrelated histories
Open Bell Pepper History and verify the recorded outcome and recommendation are visible
success_criteria: Numeric and date fields are serialized correctly
Failed persistence does not discard the user's draft
Strong and weak recommendations cite only matching garden history
No history recommendation is invented when no outcome exists
records.environment_scope: local deterministic and rendered sample-garden browser; remote persistence excluded
tests: website/tests/plant-timeline-interactions.test.tsx::records a complete harvest or lesson and closes after confirmation

records.behavior: A follow-up started from an older Garden Ask answer keeps that answer's plant context instead of inheriting the newest turn's plant links.
records.fixtures: Existing Garden Ask property with tomato plant A and basil plant B in separate beds
steps: Ask a question about tomato A and wait for its answer
Ask a second question about basil B and wait for its answer
Start What changed since last time? from tomato A's older answer
Verify the resulting follow-up links to tomato A and not basil B
success_criteria: The follow-up uses the selected older answer as its comparison context
The follow-up plant link remains tomato A even when basil B is the newest turn
No link to basil B is added to the follow-up started from tomato A
records.safety: synthetic plant fixtures and mocked diagnosis callback; no persistence or provider call
